title: Season of Growth
tagline: The Grove awakens. Life stirs beneath the soil.
description: Spring is the Grove's season. Exclusive seasonal items drop during this window: Seedling Crown, Dewdrop Charm, and the legendary Spring Blossom. Seasonal quests rotate alongside daily and weekly quests.

title: Season of Flame
tagline: The Ember Circle blazes. Passion runs unchecked.
description: Summer is the Ember Circle's season. Exclusive seasonal items drop during this window: Sunforge Shard, Inferno Ash, and the legendary Solar Heart. Seasonal quests rotate alongside daily and weekly quests.

title: Season of Reflection
tagline: The Mirror Lake deepens. Truths surface in stillness.
description: Autumn is the Mirror Lake's season. Exclusive seasonal items drop during this window: Amber Leaf, Fog Crystal, and the legendary Harvest Mirror. Seasonal quests rotate alongside daily and weekly quests.

title: Season of Dreams
tagline: The Moonroot Tree slumbers. Wisdom grows in darkness.
description: Winter is the Moonroot Tree's season. Exclusive seasonal items drop during this window: Frost Whisper, Starfall Dust, and the legendary Dreamweave Shard. Seasonal quests rotate alongside daily and weekly quests.
